dict.string: StickyBot talks to your stick over Bluetooth: its settings, approvals, alerts and voice requests.
StickyBot taps only its own sound to make the stick's Bluetooth mic.
StickyBot reads your calendar to show your next meeting on the stick and remind you before it starts. It never changes your calendar.
